hypothesis: With the corrected first-update gradient contract, fixed source-aware P_bg plus a zero-initialized WKB truth-P_bg residual will complete two finite updates and preserve exact full-field evaluation on Marmousi source-holdout panels below the 4 GiB resource gate.
expected_mechanism: P_bg supplies source position, onset, phase and causality; the neural branch learns only heterogeneous scattering. The final zero head opens on update one, after which all encoders must recover nonzero gradients.

single_conceptual_variable.name: zero_head_first_update_gradient_contract
single_conceptual_variable.parent: incorrectly require upstream gradients before the zero head opens
single_conceptual_variable.candidate: require local_field on update one and all live encoders from update two
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: model, caches, panels, residual target, optimizer, learning rates, seed and metric

primary_metric: two finite residual updates, update-two upstream gradients, exact P_bg reconstruction and bound artifacts
failure_signal: Any cache miss, update-two missing encoder gradient, non-finite value, OOM, missing binding, or peak CUDA above 4 GiB blocks long training.
rollback: Preserve all caches and artifacts. On failure do not launch the long run.
command: same as r28 with artifact/preregistration replaced by r28b
